content.title: Scale Expansion | Tiny Material Grows into a World, Then Returns Exactly
content.summary: Lock a recognizable tiny material anchor and one visible trigger. Let that same material expand through readable scale levels into a complete world, hold the apex, then reverse every layer along the same lineage and optical axis until the opening anchor and trigger relationship are restored exactly.

quick_start.input_format: Tiny material anchor + visible trigger + at least two scale-expansion levels + held maximum-scale world + exact return along the same material lineage
quick_start.recommended_input: On the floor of an original black-oak theatre, a compact knot of white wool rests beneath a brass tuning fork. A small striker hits once, with the wool, fork feet, and wood grain clearly registered. The same fibers expand into layered cloud bands, then a slate ridge and room-scale weather. One fine wool thread keeps the sky connected to the floor origin. The ridge contracts into mist, mist into cloud, and cloud into fibers that re-form the identical wool knot beneath the same fork, restoring the opening composition.
required_anchors: Establish one compact material anchor, surrounding surface and visible trigger before expansion.
Let fragments of the anchor visibly generate the first larger structure.
Hold one complete maximum-scale world before contraction begins.
Reverse the same lineage and optical axis to restore the original anchor and trigger relationship.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Lock a recognizable tiny material anchor and one visible trigger. Let that same material expand through readable scale levels into a complete world, hold the apex, then reverse every layer along the same lineage and optical axis until the opening anchor and trigger relationship are restored exactly.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one small, materially specific anchor and one visible trigger in a stable composition. Expand fragments of that same material through several readable scale levels until they form a complete world, while retaining at least one origin cue. Hold the maximum scale, then reverse the same material lineage and camera axis until the original anchor, trigger relationship and surrounding surface are restored for an exact visual loop.

invariants.rule: Establish one compact material anchor, surrounding surface and visible trigger before expansion.
invariants.purpose: Defines an exact state to recover.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic glow has no material history.

invariants.rule: Let fragments of the anchor visibly generate the first larger structure.
invariants.purpose: Binds scale change to one material family.
invariants.ablation_failure: A hard cut to a new world breaks causality.

invariants.rule: Expand through at least two readable scale levels while retaining an origin cue.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate maximum scale feels like an unrelated reveal.

invariants.rule: Hold one complete maximum-scale world before contraction begins.
invariants.purpose: Creates a clear apex and reversal threshold.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous blur hides whether expansion completed.

invariants.rule: Reverse the same lineage and optical axis to restore the original anchor and trigger relationship.
invariants.ablation_failure: Returning to a similar but different object is only a thematic echo.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source mixed chili and seed spice pile
the source adult fingers pinching the pile
the source orange-blue galaxy and planet arrangement
the source Yapper watermark and exact spice-cosmos-spice composition
